blocks.html: Where all combustion, ventilation, and dilution air is to be provided by outdoor air, the required combustion, ventilation, and dilution air shall be obtained by direct opening by louver or a duct(s) from the boiler room to the outdoors. Openings connecting the room to the outdoor air shall comply with Sections 703.1.1 through 703.1.2 of this code, and Figures 304.6.1(1), 304.6.1(2), 304.6.1(3) and 304.6.2 of the New York City Fuel Gas Code. The size of the openings connecting the room to the outdoor air supply shall also comply with any applicable rules of the New York City Department of Environmental Protection.
